title: test.close, test.text and test.bytes pass on equal values
purpose: Run embedded tests whose float, text and byte assertions hold.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for #187 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 14: 0.1 + 0.2 is within 1e-12 of 0.3, -2.5 within 0.1000001 of -2.4, and the texts and byte arrays are equal, so every test passes and the CLI returns 0.
